metadata.othernotes:
Monique is a mine, a form of entertainer who performs stories or skits exclusively through body language. This means that she is mute. She's not unable to talk, but simply unwilling, being very commited to her role.

Her grandfather is Jacques Lecoq, founder of École Internationale de Théâtre Jacques Lecoq, a theatre school located in France that's renowned for its influence on mime culture.

She enjoys gymnastics, swimming, and, of course, theatre.

Despite being mute, she's open to target interactions with other characters. She can answer yes or no questions, and use her body language to convey answers to other questions (check the "notes" tab to see her intent).

If your character is so inclined, you can have them try to make Monique talk. She will always refuse to talk, which might make a character even more determined to get her to.

case.name: Stripping Weirdness
case.description: Monique stripping in a variety of ways, some of which may surprise your character. Some of the most reaction-worthy ones are listed below.

case.name: Backwards Gloves
case.description: Monique may remove her gloves backwards, making them vanish from her fingertips to her wrists. Target the marker "Stripping0-3" to react to this.

case.name: Flying Hat
case.description: Monique's hat may fly off on its own, much to her confusion. Target the marker "Stripping1-3" to react to this.

case.name: Shoe Hazard
case.description: Monique may kick her boots off, sending them flying. Target the marker "Stripping2-3" to react to this.

case.name: Shirt Tricks
case.description: Monique may make her shirt vanish using a magic trick, similar to Joey. Target the marker "Stripping3-2" to react to this. She may also rip her shirt off instead, using the marker "Stripping3-3."

case.name: Sheet Trick
case.description: Monique may pull out a sheet to cover herself with while she removes her bra. Target the marker "Stripping4-2" to react to this -- be mindful of which case you target this in.

case.name: Vanishing Bra
case.description: Monique's bra may instantaneously vanish, only to appear in her pocket somehow. Target the marker "Stripping4-3" to react to this.

case.name: Fake Socks
case.description: Monique may shoot her socks with water, revealing that they were painted on. Note: If she doesn't perform this trick, they were real socks. Target the marker "Stripping5-3" to react to this.

case.name: Pocket Panties
case.description: Monique may notice a scarf sticking out from her pocket, only to pull on it and find that her panties are tied onto the end of the scarf chain. Target the marker "Stripping6-3" to react -- be mindful of the case.

case.name: Panty Rip
case.description: Monique may reach a hand into her skirt to pull her panties out without stepping out of them, which may or may not involve ripping them. Target the marker "Stripping6-2" to react to this.

case.name: Fading Skirt
case.description: Monique may make her skirt fade out of existence. Target the marker "Stripping7-3" to react to this. She may also slingshot her skirt off of her body, using the marker "Stripping7-2."

case.name: Silent Orgasm
case.description: Monique is so comitted to her act, she's even silent through her forfeit, including her orgasm.

notes.note: Monique resents the idea that mimes are lesser than clowns.
Monique is wondering why she needed an invitation to play.
